lines.text: God tells Israel to be holy, to respect their mother and father, and not to make molten gods.
A peace offering may be eaten on the day it is sacrificed or the next day, and leftovers on the third day must be burned.
Israel must leave the edges of the field and the fallen grapes for the priests and the Levites.
God tells Israel to rebuke a neighbor directly, not to seek revenge or bear a grudge, and to love their neighbor as themselves.
Fruit from newly planted trees is forbidden for seven years, offered to the LORD in the fourth year, and eaten in the fifth.
